title: readme
description: The specification readme-writer composes in Decide and hands to scripts/render_readme.py (SDS-S-080, a skill-local shape). Section order follows the Standard Readme convention (name, tagline, background, install, usage, maintainers/contributing, license): the reader's questions in the order a reader asks them. Commands are structured, not prose, so the script can check each against the repository's declared commands.

tagline.description: One sentence: what it is and who it is for.

background.description: Why it exists; omitted when the tagline is enough.

develop.description: How to run the tests and the linter; omitted for a repository with no declared development commands.

license.description: An SPDX identifier where one applies (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0).

output.description: What the reader should see, when it helps.
